name: kashflow
description: Read and optionally write IRIS KashFlow accounting data (customers, suppliers, invoices, receipts, journals, nominals, and bank) through the SOAP API.

KASHFLOW_USERNAME.title: KashFlow SOAP API username
KASHFLOW_USERNAME.description: SOAP API UserName from the KashFlow account. This is not the REST memorable word.

KASHFLOW_PASSWORD.title: KashFlow SOAP API password
KASHFLOW_PASSWORD.description: SOAP API Password. Stored as a secret by Cursor and never logged by the server. This is not the REST memorable word.

KASHFLOW_READ_ONLY.title: Read only
KASHFLOW_READ_ONLY.description: When true, only read tools are registered and write SOAP calls are blocked. Set false to enable insert_customer, insert_supplier, insert_invoice, insert_receipt2, and insert_journal.
